notes.title: Block Story Version 10.5.1 Now Available on Full Release
notes.notes:
It has been a long journey, but Version 10.5.1 of Block Story is now ready for full release!
 
We believe this version is a completely different experience than players had during our far too long Early Access period.  And, we will make sure that Block Story continues to receive our utmost attention on STEAM.
 
While playing Block Story, you use diamonds to purchase tools, PETs, weapons, and everything else an adventurer could desire.  Diamonds are accumulated by mining, as loot dropped from defeated enemies and can be purchased using your Steam Wallet.  However, the game is designed so that you would never have to buy a single diamond to level up, ride dragons and 29 other creatures, cast spells or acquire magic potions and provide food and health items for your growing pets and dragons.  The purchasing of diamonds is for convenience only.
 
We realize that some PC players do not like microtransactions in the games the play.  If you are one of those players, please do not buy our game.
 
One more thing, if you have any questions about Block Story, we promise to respond to those questions in 24 hours or less.  Just contact us at support@blockstory.net.

notes.title: Block Story Scheduled for Full Release in December
notes.notes:
After way too long for us and our players, Block Story will be moving to full release in Early November.  If you already own Block Story, please check out our BETA version 10.4.11 in your STEAM account by right clicking in Block Story, click on properties, BETAs and select the BETA branch.

So what’s new?

•	Discover several new exciting quests 
•	Earn achievement badges as you level up
•	Learn from a wise Wizard on how to play
•	Ride on dragons and 29 other creatures and pets
•	Level up your hero with customized stats and attributes
•	Use the crafting system to forge a slew of magical items
•	Battle the Dragon Lord if you dare!

Our new version offers Google Wallet purchases for diamonds for your convenience only.  You do not need to purchase a single diamond to play Block Story.  Purchasing diamonds are only for players who would like achieve items quicker and faster.  If you have any questions about this, please contact us at support@blockstory.net.
